blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of V208 crouch and sit renders shows both thighs projecting in front of the overskirt and the shorts hems through to the knees. The lilac front hem folds back beside and behind the knees; pointed fabric edges hang below the seat.

The V208 prone render still shows front overskirt fabric collecting beneath the hips in overlapping folds. Standing front, three-quarter and natural pose show weaker angular front-pleat creasing than V207, but the side view retains a stepped outward panel silhouette.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
